Other things equal, the higher the price, the greater the quantity supplied; supply curve slopes up.
Price at which quantity demanded equals quantity supplied; the market clears.
Above equilibrium: surplus (supplied > demanded), price falls. Below: shortage, price rises.

back: Natural (climate, soil, water), economic (capital, prices, markets, labour), social, government, risk.

front: Why do tomato prices swing more than grain prices?
back: Tomatoes are perishable and cannot be stored, so harvest gluts and off-season shortages move the price.
